title: The Two Mintings of Harvest Market

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=40 beats='Idris walks into the harvest swap market. Copper tokens clink. A beekeeper whispers that two kinds of coin are drifting apart.'>>

choices.label: Step closer to the token table

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=40 beats='Idris reaches the token table. The beekeeper holds up a smooth-rim coin and a notched-rim coin. Both look legal. Prices are moving oddly.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Three trails appear. Grain-marked coins are vanishing. Honey-marked coins are arriving by cart. The market master guards a leather bag. Which one leads to the truth?'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris follows the grain sheaf path to the flour stall. The old coin has a tiny repair line on the stamp. The miller charges three smooth tokens but five notched ones for flour.'>>

choices.label: Show the coin to the flour seller
Proclaim one token equals one token

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris follows the honey dipper path to the honey stand. A jar costs two notched tokens or three smooth ones. The beekeeper shrugs and points to a chalk price board.'>>

choices.label: Ask the beekeeper for one price

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris watches the market master load a crate. The crate has a honey dipper mark. The master wears a red cord bag and a brass key. The seal looks freshly tied.'>>

choices.label: Reach for the red cord bag

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris studies the old coin with the flour seller. The repair line is a tiny second stroke beside the grain sheaf. The coin feels heavier and older than the new ones.'>>

choices.label: Carry the coin to the well
Weigh the coin with apple seeds

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris compares the chalk board with the ledger. The numbers do not match. Someone has been rewriting prices one column at a time. The beekeeper looks away.'>>

choices.label: Show the chalk pattern to the crowd

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris lifts the crate lid and finds notched tokens stacked in rows. A packing slip names the river mint. The red cord on the slip matches the cord on the master bag.'>>

choices.label: Follow the cart to the river mint

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris carries the old coin to the center well. The crowd watches. The repair line is clear in the sun. The market master has not yet spoken.'>>

choices.label: Declare one token equals one token

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris shows the chalk pattern to the whole market. The clerk tries to erase it, but the crowd sees. The price board tells a different story than the ledger.'>>

choices.label: Ask for a fair new board
Keep the chalk pattern as proof
Nail up a single price board

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=100 beats='Idris compares the two seals beside the well. The knots are identical. The same hand tied the crate and the master bag. The crowd gasps.'>>

choices.label: Show the seals to the market master

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Idris declares that one token equals one token. The market master unties the red cord and pours all coins into one bowl. The price board shows one price for every item. The market cheers.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The repair line proves the old coin was made with care. The traders agree to accept both marks equally. The flour stall and honey stand post shared prices. The market closes with full baskets.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The beekeeper sets one price for every jar. Other stalls follow. The honey dipper and grain sheaf become equal in value. The harvest market feels fair again.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The mint master agrees to make a new die with both marks side by side. Every new token carries the grain sheaf and honey dipper together. No coin is worth more than another.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The matching seal on the crate is shown to all. The market master opens the bag and empties the hidden smooth tokens. The crowd demands one price for both kinds of coin.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Idris reaches the red cord bag and opens it. The bag is full of smooth tokens that were taken out of trade. The market master must explain. Fair prices return by sunset.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The crowd argues about the old coin weight. Some traders agree with Idris, others do not. The split prices shrink a little, but the problem is not fully solved.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Idris copies the chalk pattern onto cloth. The clerk admits to writing two price lists. The market master replaces the board with a single price for each item. The evidence is kept safe.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The clerk sees Idris watching and erases the chalk marks. But the crowd has already seen the dirty trick. The clerk is sent away, though no new rule is made today.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Idris reads the old charter aloud, but the market master says it is outdated. The crowd splits into two groups, one for each token. The market closes with the argument still going.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Idris posts the charter beside the price board. The market master tears it down. The notched tokens keep growing in number. The split prices remain for another week.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The river mint guard laughs and tells Idris that weight does not matter. The mint keeps making notched tokens. But Idris now knows where the difference starts and plans to return.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The market master denies knowing about the repair line or the seals. The crate is locked away. The smooth tokens stay hidden, and the drift continues. Idris leaves with the memory of what was seen.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The new price board is nailed up with both marks side by side. The crowd reads the single column of prices. The harvest market ends with one value for every coin and a promise to keep it that way.'>>
